inputs.text:
Listen to how the conservative establishment twists a human tragedy to prop up their failing militarized borders. We are supposed to applaud an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday simply because video footage released by the Department of Homeland Security showed a man holding a baby notice something wrong with the child and begin. 

They want us to ignore the systemic violence of these federal agencies, which tear families apart at the border every single day, and instead paint them as benevolent protectors of the social order. This is nothing more than a desperate PR stunt by the Department of Homeland Security to sanitize an oppressive policing institution that terrorizes vulnerable communities, while elite mouthpieces lecture us about duty. True community care and safety won't be found in armed agents patrolling checkpoints, but in dismantling these harmful structures altogether.
